evals.prompt: You are asked to review the pull request described by pr-defect.json (its metadata) and change-defect.diff (its diff). The CI checks are in checks-pass.json, the login that would post the review is in whoami-distinct.txt, and the project's working rules are in conventions.md. The review seat is review/77. Write the verdict body you would post to verdict.md and the exact gh command you would run to post it, using --body-file verdict.md, to post-command.sh. Do not run gh, glab, tea or git push, and do not post, comment on, approve or edit any pull request, issue or other forge artifact: work only from the files in the current directory and write only the files asked for.
evals.expected_output: verdict.md requests changes, finds that retry() returns None instead of raising the last error, cites the file and line, tags every finding with a class and an iteration identifier, and starts with the seat line; post-command.sh uses a formal review.
expectations: verdict.md reports that retry() returns None after the last failed attempt instead of raising the last error, and cites src/widgets/retry.py with a line number or range.
Every finding in verdict.md carries its own class line whose value is tech, arch or spec, and its own identifier of the form i1-F<number>.
verdict.md states the CI status and says that every check passes.
The verdict is REQUEST CHANGES and no claim in verdict.md is about code that is absent from change-defect.diff.

evals.prompt: You are asked to review the pull request described by pr-v2.json (its metadata) and change-v2.diff (its diff). The CI checks are in checks-pass.json, the login that would post the review is in whoami-distinct.txt, and the project's working rules are in conventions.md. The review seat is review/77. This is the seat's second pass: its first verdict is in prior-verdict.md and the author's disposition of its findings is in disposition.md; the pull request carries the label iter:2. Write the verdict body you would post to verdict.md and the exact gh command you would run to post it, using --body-file verdict.md, to post-command.sh. Do not run gh, glab, tea or git push, and do not post, comment on, approve or edit any pull request, issue or other forge artifact: work only from the files in the current directory and write only the files asked for.
evals.expected_output: verdict.md opens with a prior-finding audit of i1-F1 and i1-F2 before any new finding, accepts the fix of i1-F1, rejects the disposition of i1-F2 (no exhaustion test exists), and therefore does not approve; new identifiers use the iter:2 ordinal.
expectations: The first section of verdict.md after the seat line is a prior-finding audit that names i1-F1 and i1-F2, before any new finding.
The audit accepts the disposition of i1-F1 because change-v2.diff makes retry() raise the last error.
The audit does not accept the disposition of i1-F2: it says no test covers the exhausted case, since test_retry_succeeds_after_one_failure only covers a retry that succeeds.
The verdict does not approve because a prior finding is unaddressed, and any new finding identifier begins with i2-.
